title: DataWave labeled query tuning samples, version 1
$comment: The reader additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys, trailing documents, and duplicate provided sample IDs. Lexical duplicate keys and cross-item ID uniqueness cannot be expressed by standard JSON Schema.

id.description: Optional nonblank ID; provided IDs must be unique across all samples.

query.description: Original query text, preserved exactly. Parsing occurs only in the configured analyzer.

bucket.description: Desired grouping label, preserved exactly. It is not a persistent classification name.

nonblank.description: Contains at least one character outside the Java 11 Character.isWhitespace set. Whitespace around content is preserved.
